visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A grand red wooden torii gate stands isolated in calm blue sea water under a bright, cloudless sky. Bright yellow text overlays the center. (2) A man with short black hair wearing sunglasses and a navy blue sweater stands on a shore, holding his hand out as if balancing a tiny version of the distant torii gate. (3) View from the interior of a convertible car driving over a bridge at dusk; the man is seen from a top-down angle wearing a black beanie. (4) A white and red passenger ferry is docked at a modern terminal with mountains in the background. (5) A tall stone lantern pillar stands at the entrance of a busy street filled with tourists walking between traditional wooden shops. (6) A brown wild deer is resting on a patch of dirt under trees, while a crowd of people is visible in the distant background. (7) A close-up of a paper ticket showing a picture of the Itsukushima Shrine is held up against the real red shrine structure in the background. (8) The camera pans across the floating red shrine corridors built on stilts over the water with mountains behind. (9) The man walks along a quiet sandy beach with the sea and the red torii gate on his left. (10) The man is seen from the back sitting in a modern wooden cafe, looking out of a window at a panoramic view of the bay and traditional rooftops. (11) A platter of food is shown, featuring deep-fried oysters with lemon, grilled oysters, and oyster rice with seaweed. (12) The man uses chopsticks to lift a large, succulent oyster toward the camera. (13) Inside a retail store, various white sake bottles and glasses with blue mountain logos are neatly arranged on wooden shelves.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 日本三大景 嚴島神社要怎麼玩? [Variety]: 日本三大景 嚴島神社要怎麼玩? (2) [Subtitle]: 讓你省下一小時的排隊時間. (3) [Subtitle]: 我正在執行一個. (4) [Subtitle]: 自駕穿越日本的計劃. (5) [Subtitle]: 今天要出發前往嚴島神社. (6) [Subtitle]: 我把車停在宮島口. (7) [Subtitle]: 搭渡輪前往嚴島. (8) [Subtitle]: 渡輪的班次很多. (9) [Subtitle]: 幾乎沒有等待就上船了. (10) [Subtitle]: 我一開始有疑問. (11) [Subtitle]: 這個島到底叫宮島還是嚴島. (12) [Subtitle]: 後來才知道宮島是俗稱. (13) [Subtitle]: 意思是神明所居住的那個神宮. (14) [Subtitle]: 所在的島 俗稱宮島. (15) [Subtitle]: 總之呢 嚴島就是宮島. (16) [Subtitle]: 由於是日本三大景. (17) [Subtitle]: 觀光客非常多. (18) [Subtitle]: 登島後 順著人潮走. (19) [Subtitle]: 就可以到達嚴島神社. (20) [Subtitle]: 島上也有許多野生的小鹿. (21) [Subtitle]: 那要特別注意. (22) [Subtitle]: 這裡的鹿是嚴禁餵食的. (23) [Subtitle]: 因此他們也不會像奈良的鹿一樣. (24) [Subtitle]: 圍著人類搶食. (25) [Subtitle]: 嚴島神社的一大特色. (26) [Subtitle]: 是整個神社懸浮在海上. (27) [Subtitle]: 漲潮時可以看到神社的倒影. (28) [Subtitle]: 而來這裡. (29) [Subtitle]: 當然要跟海上大鳥居合照. (30) [Subtitle]: 但主流的拍照景點非常多人. (31) [Subtitle]: 中間還有一個燈座會擋住. (32) [Subtitle]: 我覺得沒有很好拍. (33) [Subtitle]: 我自己更往神社裡面走. (34) [Subtitle]: 有一個小沙灘. (35) [Subtitle]: 這個沙灘人不但少很多. (36) [Subtitle]: 也可以同時拍到海上大鳥居. (37) [Subtitle]: 接著前往遊客少很多的咖啡廳. (38) [Subtitle]: 牡蠣祝. (39) [Subtitle]: 要稍微爬一下樓梯. (40) [Subtitle]: 但好處是人少. (41) [Subtitle]: 又可以從高處喝著咖啡看廣島灣. (42) [Subtitle]: 非常地愜意. (43) [Subtitle]: 而來宮島當然也要吃牡蠣. (44) [Subtitle]: 這裡有好幾家有名的牡蠣餐廳. (45) [Subtitle]: 我選的是牡蠣屋. (46) [Subtitle]: 這裡的餐廳大多六點就打烊. (47) [Subtitle]: 所以建議各位最好下午前就來. (48) [Subtitle]: 免得賣完. (49) [Subtitle]: 我點的牡蠣套餐有. (50) [Subtitle]: 炸牡蠣 烤牡蠣跟牡蠣蓋飯. (51) [Subtitle]: 牡蠣都非常地新鮮好吃. (52) [Subtitle]: 宮島上還有一間beams. (53) [Subtitle]: 有賣各種宮島限定. (54) [Subtitle]: 吃飽後在附近逛逛也很舒服. [Logo]: BEAMS JAPAN.
